title: Einstein's Quotes
author: Mark Edmonds
content:
The late great Albert Einstein came up with some memorable quotes. Here are just some that ring true with us every day:

  • We can't solve problems by using the same kind of thinking we used when we created them (also see Challenging Assumptions)

  • No problem can be solved from the same level of consciousness that created it

  • You can never solve a problem on the level on which it was created

  • A person who never made a mistake never tried anything new

  • Everything should be as simple as it is, but not simpler

  • Information is not knowledge

  • Insanity: doing the same thing over and over again and expecting different results

  • Once we accept our limits, we go beyond them

  • The difference between stupidity and genius is that genius has its limits - Intellectuals solve problems, geniuses prevent them
